newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-CRISTAL SHOCK VELEZ WITH LATE WINNER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CRISTAL SHOCK VELEZ WITH LATE WINNER.

text.p: Peruvian champions Sporting Cristal snatched a winning goal at the death to knock former champions Velez Sarsfield out of the South American Libertadores Cup on Thursday.

The Argentines, winners in 1994, had held Cristal to a 0-0 draw in Lima in the first leg of the second round tie but were unable to capitalise on their apparent advantage against a well-organised Peruvian defence.

Velez, captained by volatile Paraguayan goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, paid the penalty two minutes from the end when Jorge Soto scored the only goal of the match to give Cristal a shock 1-0 win on aggregate.
It was the first time for 30 years that a Peruvian team had won a Libertadores match in Argentina.
Racing Club, considered the least likely of the three Argentine representatives to win the trophy, are now the country's only team left in the competition.
They knocked local rivals and defending champions River Plate out of the competition on Wednesday.
Cristal join Bolivar (Bolivia), Gremio (Brazil) and Penarol (Uruguay), who are already into the quarter-finals. The remaining three ties are due to be settled next week.
